log.detail: Have any specific human-in-the-loop validation processes or automated rollback mechanisms been planned for the entity extraction and relationship mapping?
What specific security controls (e.g., model scanners, data sanitization, or access controls) are planned to protect the knowledge graph from data poisoning or unauthorized data inference?
Where are the completed Privacy Threshold Assessment (PTA) and/or Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) stored for this project (e.g., specific document management system, case file, or repository)?
Has the department established a clear definition and measurement framework for fairness in the context of AI-driven entity extraction from internal communications?
Have the primary users (departmental staff and policy researchers) and IT/data governance teams been consulted regarding the design and deployment of the knowledge graph?
Will the system's interface disclose when relationships are AI-generated, provide explanations for those links, and offer a non-AI search alternative?

Has the department consulted with its internal legal team or the Attorney-General's Department regarding the privacy and secrecy implications of ingesting employee email archives into an AI-powered knowledge graph?
Are there any specific agency-enabling statutes or secrecy provisions that restrict the sharing or cross-referencing of the internal documents and communications planned for ingestion?
Has a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) been scheduled or completed for the Departmental Knowledge Graph project?
Does the ingested unstructured data (e.g., policy documents, meeting minutes, email archives) contain Indigenous data or information relating to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people?

Have any recordkeeping processes or metadata standards been defined for capturing the AI-extracted entities, relationships, and system configuration into the department's approved records management system?
Is the AI model or system being procured from an external vendor, or is it being developed in-house?
What plans, if any, have been established for testing, piloting, and continuously monitoring the AI system's performance and reliability?
What training processes or programs will be implemented to ensure operators and users are sufficiently skilled?
